editorial:
Imagine walking into a giant department store after the lights go out and the doors are locked. That is exactly where you land with this zany cartoon. C. Fields. The vibe is totally playful and imaginative, turning a boring store into a wonderland of gags. It feels like a fever dream where everyday objects come to life, and the energy never lets up. You will love how the animation plays with your expectations, turning simple store displays into wild comedy bits.

What really makes this work is the fast pacing and the clever visual jokes. From painting that changes right before your eyes to a poker table that cheats, there is always something happening. The highlight is definitely the interaction between the tour guide and the chatty Blabbermouse. If you enjoy old-school slapstick humor, you should definitely check this out. It is a quick watch that still feels fresh.
endingExplained: The chaos peaks in the gift-wrap section where you see robots handling ribbons and packages. Blabbermouse cannot stop talking, and his constant babbling finally pushes things too far. The wrapping machine catches him and wraps the poor mouse up tightly in paper. To top it off, a sticker that says Do Not Open Until Xmas is slapped right over his mouth, finally giving the other mice some peace and quiet.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves vintage cartoons and slapstick comedy.
